title: I built a platform that hides what happened next on a real market chart—and makes you commit to a prediction
author: BullishBearChart

comments.author: retakeourbase
comments.body: What did you use to build the front-end of that site?

replies.author: BullishBearChart
replies.body: The frontend is built with React and TypeScript, with custom CSS and interactive SVG charts. What do you think of it? If you haven’t already, sign up for a free account and give it a try - we’d love to hear your feedback.

replies.author: retakeourbase
replies.body: It looks great. I could learn a thing or two from it. Thank you.
